title: Bulk Import Preview, Validation & AI Enrichment

intro.title: Bulk Preview & AI Enrichment
intro.subtitle: Interactive row validation, AI auto-enrichment of manufacturers and categories, and 1-click catalog import

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 4, Part 6: Bulk Import Preview, Validation, and AI Enrichment. Once your CSV is parsed, MediFlow validates every row to keep your catalog error-free.
Examine the status dashboard: Green rows indicate valid entries, while yellow warnings flag missing MRPs or quantities that require your attention.
Click Auto-Enrich Missing Data. MediFlow's AI scans Indian pharma drug databases to automatically fill missing manufacturers, salts, and therapeutic categories.
Inspect the refreshed table. Warnings resolve automatically as accurate market MRPs and manufacturer brands are appended.
Click Import All Data to commit the items. Hundreds of medicines and traceable batches are generated simultaneously, ready for immediate counter billing.

outro.takeaway: Validation & AI Enrichment: Preview parsed spreadsheet rows, auto-fill missing pharmaceutical metadata using AI, and commit clean inventory batches with one click.
